name: Kali
source: Kali was found by fairies at a young age and was held captive by them for most of her life. Due to this she is incredibly distrustful and has difficulty opening up to others. With her brash attitude, it is often harder for her to endear herself to strangers. When she does get close to someone, she will unapologetically protect them. She takes the same blanket whenever she travels and always smells it before sleeping.
